Apple iPhone 16 product bezel — local design preview only

Official source page:
https://developer.apple.com/design/resources/

Official package URL:
https://devimages-cdn.apple.com/design/resources/download/Bezel-iPhone-16.dmg

Original package path:
PNG/iPhone 16/iPhone 16 - Black - Portrait.png

Local copy:
iphone-16-black-portrait.png

Downloaded and extracted on 2026-10-29. The human user explicitly
approved using the official template after the license was presented.
The disk image was then mounted read-only. No software was installed.
The PNG is an unchanged, byte-for-byte copy of the official asset.

SHA-256:
946575d68516ed911ef41e76532e898cedafa3ee220a9528507606616f20054e

Original raster size:
1359 x 2736 pixels, RGBA

Screen opening:
x=90, y=90, width=1179, height=2556
Coordinates are in original raster pixels. The bounding rectangle
contains rounded screen corners, which remain masked by the original
bezel asset. Use this PNG above the screen content without cropping,
retouching or adding a separate shadow to the Apple product image.

The PNG already contains the Dynamic Island and camera artwork.
Measured nontransparent island bounding box:
x=492, y=123, width=375, height=112
Do not draw another Dynamic Island over this official artwork.

The package contains portrait/landscape product bezel PNG and PSD
assets plus the license. It does not contain a Home Screen screenshot,
system app icons or a standalone iOS UI Kit. Screen content in the
prototype is custom and must not be described as an Apple UI Kit.
